name: completed_widgets
description: Count of orders whose status is Completed.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_widgets FROM your_order_table WHERE status = 'Completed'

name: revenue_in_period
description: Sum of amount for successful payments in [start_date, end_date). Shows the {start_date}/{end_date} template pattern -- both are validated as strict YYYY-MM-DD before substitution.
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue_in_period FROM your_payment_table WHERE status = 'Success' AND payment_date >= '{start_date}' AND payment_date < '{end_date}'
